title: Najuta kununua mashine ya kukimbia kwa sababu imekaa tu

text.I regret buying a running machine becaus: Najuta kununua mashine ya kukimbia kwa sababu imekaa tu
text.It is heavy, and just having it in my si: Ni nzito, na kuwa nayo tu machoni pangu hufanya hali yangu kushuka kidogo.
text.Because it makes me feel, ah, I have to: Kwa sababu inanifanya nihisi, ah, lazima nifanye mazoezi.
text.The running machine, in its natural habi: Mashine inayoendesha, katika makazi yake ya asili
text.My need to write things down works like: Haja yangu ya kuandika mambo hufanya kazi kama choo
